info.title: Blocksize Market Data
info.description: Filtered production Blocksize API with strict canonical Pay.sh request contracts: free discovery/readiness and x402-paid multi-asset observations and workflows. Explicit symbols are required for client-side spending intent; legacy aliases and implicit watchlists are not exposed. Catalog presence does not guarantee live readiness.
